description: National geoportal of Moldova (INDS metadata catalogue and geodata portal) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Agency for Land Relations and Cadastre of the Republic of Moldova (ARFC). Presentations of the Moldovan national spatial data infrastructure describe a metadata catalogue of spatial data and network services at geoportalinds.gov.md and a thematic geoportal at geodata.gov.md that provides network services, set up under Law no. 254 which transposes the INSPIRE Directive. Coverage: Republic of Moldova. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated; not read. Caveats: the portal pages returned a service-unavailable error, so the themes, formats and licence are unknown, and hazard layers were not confirmed. It can support finding Moldovan spatial data on networks and land for infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30 but its text could not be read; statements come from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
